2. Perspective/DOF: The varying sharpness in petals is consistent with macro photography depth-of-field limitations. Flagging this as an AI artifact (severity 1.0) might be a false positive; real macro shots often have irregular focus planes. 
3. Missed Artifact: The beetle lacks visible legs. While some beetles tuck legs, the complete absence of any leg structures or shadows suggesting legs underneath is a subtle anatomical omission common in AI generation. The Router missed this specific anatomical defect, focusing only on texture/boundary.
